gruss_morgen.text: Good morning! Smell that? Fresh leather and possibilities. Mostly leather.

gruss_tag.text: Welcome to the saddlery! Watch your step — needles with ambitions everywhere.

gruss_abend.text: Still up? Me too. A seam gave me a crooked look. I will not take that sitting down.

gruss_regen.text: Rainy weather! Perfect. They say stitching is most honest in the rain. Well, I say that.

gruss_freund.text: There you are! I cleared the good chair for you. The one with only one needle in it.

text: A halter for a pony with very firm opinions. It wants glitter. It gets glitter.
You don't argue with ponies. You just lose more elegantly.
A double seam, eight stitches per thumb's width. The royal league. The opera of the craft.
You're actually listening, aren't you? Most people flee at the words double seam.
Between us: I'm stitching a secret project. It has four buckles and your name on it.
That's all I'm saying. Unless you bring cake. No! Stay strong, Selma.

quest_vergabe.text: Since you're here — I could use someone with hands and heart. I'll provide the needle.

optionen.text: I'm a bit tied up in knots...

quest_annahme.text: Wonderful! Work cleanly, yes? I can see crooked results through three walls.

ablehnung.text: No problem. Good work is happy to wait. So is bad work, mind you — it has nothing better to do.

quest_abgabe.text: Let me see... checked stitch by stitch and... flawless! You could stitch houses onto people. Here, your pay.

geschenk_liebt.text: WOOL! Soft, wonderful wool! I must make something out of it immediately. You get the first piece!

geschenk_mag.text: How thoughtful! This goes on the shelf of honor. Next to the pincushion. Its name is Norbert.

geschenk_normal.text: Oh. Thank you! I'll... find a use for it. I ALWAYS find a use. That is a threat.

text: My first saddle? A catastrophe. Crooked as a barn door in the wind.
The horse looked at it, looked at me — and sat down on it. On the saddle. Like a chair.
That's when I knew: I had to get better. Or build chairs. It was a close call.
The seam up there? That's Mom's. Her last piece before she handed the workshop to me.
She said: never copy it. Make it better. I've tried a thousand times.
I'm at nine hundred ninety-nine. But shhh — the seam is listening.

tschuess.text: See you soon! And if anything tears anywhere: breathe first, then come to me.
